name: Jenn Wexler
bio: Jennifer Wexler is an American filmmaker. She is best known for directing the films The Ranger (2018), The Sacrifice Game (2023) and The Last Temptation of Becky (2026).

credits.title: The Last Temptation of Becky
credits.overview: Now working as a field agent for the CIA, Becky is sent undercover to Poland to infiltrate a family of innkeepers running a tourist venture at The Wolf's Lair, Hitler's WWII bunker. After learning that the father, Wilhelm Reuss, is on a mission to bring about the Fourth Reich, Becky takes matters into her own hands.

credits.title: 1000 Women in Horror
credits.overview: Is horror a man’s world? You might assume so – but you won’t be thinking that way for long once you investigate the vast contribution women have made to horror movies for well over a century. credits.title: The Sacrifice Game
credits.overview: Christmas break, 1971. Samantha and Clara, two students who are staying behind for the holidays at their boarding school, must survive the night after the arrival of uninvited visitors.

credits.title: Bed
credits.overview: Seemingly terrified of her own bed, Madeline locks herself in her room for weeks in an attempt to confront her fears. But what begins as an absurd, domestic quest turns into a genuine fight for redemption and revenge.

credits.title: Tales of the Uncanny
credits.overview: A detailed look at the history of horror anthology films.

credits.title: Depraved
credits.overview: A field surgeon suffering from PTSD after combat in the Middle East creates a living human out of body parts in his Brooklyn lab.

credits.title: Under the Christmas Tree
credits.overview: Produced for Glass Eye Pix as part of their 2018 Creepy Christmas Film Festival, in which each short is inspired by a holiday-themed word. This film, the sixteenth in the series, is inspired by the word "jingle bells."

credits.title: Only a Switch
credits.overview: Two lovers are on the run in this psychedelic fairy tale that blurs lines of sexuality and identity.

credits.title: The Ranger
credits.overview: After a run-in with the cops at a punk show goes sideways, Chelsea and her pals flee the city in search of a place to lay low. Running to the security of an old, abandoned family cabin in the woods, they fall under the watchful eye of an overzealous park ranger who holds a secret from Chelsea's past.

credits.title: Like Me
credits.overview: After posting a video of herself robbing a convenience store, Kiya amasses a huge social media following. A reckless loner, she seeks some form of genuine human connection. credits.title: Most Beautiful Island
credits.overview: Chronicling one harrowing day in the life of Luciana, a young woman struggling to make ends meet while striving to escape her past. As Luciana’s day unfolds, she is whisked, physically and emotionally, through a series of troublesome, unforeseeable extremes.

credits.title: Psychopaths
credits.overview: An executed serial killer, an escaped mental patient, a beautiful seductress, a crazed strangler, and a masked murderer unleash blood-soaked mayhem over the course of one night.

credits.title: Darling
credits.overview: A young woman slowly goes crazy after taking a job as the caretaker for an ancient New York home.

credits.title: ABCs of Death 2
credits.overview: Taking all that was great from the first instalment, the movie aims to be a wilder, leaner, faster-paced and even more entertaining anthology this time around, with a new crop of award-winning, visionary filmmakers from around the globe.

credits.title: Chilling Visions: 5 States of Fear
credits.overview: An anthology comprised of short films set in 5 U.S. states

credits.title: God's Country, Off Route 9
credits.overview: A debt-ridden ex-grad student is goaded into returning home to family-values country to play the part of "loyal son" in his estranged father's political campaign.
